scope: Native MAME, ordinary saved GB6-v9 input and actual MIDI receive/transmit; no guest-state forcing or physical qualification
tx_encoding: tx_bytes_hex gives exact byte sequence; tx_seconds gives corresponding timestamps in the same order
limitations: No actual Load/Save/Format execution during active sender; menu-entry attempts only
Full remote/local completion and cancellation on the native main-loop/UI paths; manufacturer41 session caller and remaining sender variants not requalified
List request arrives before D7 completes; mount request claims ownership during D8/readiness before READ CAPACITY, not necessarily before D8 status
D8 can already switch media before late Busy; no rollback claim
No new complete stack/ISR bound or physical timing/read-only proof
No firmware/runtime change; footprint remains7776/8002 with226 free and98 code-adjacent; previous748 backend suite is historical
acceptance_command_note: Commands are displayed relative to the layout working directory; each run stages a fresh isolated runtime and requires its output directory not to exist. Firmware and fixture identities are recorded above.
